GK.name: Goalkeeper
GK.description: The last line of defence. Stops shots, commands the penalty area and starts attacks with accurate distribution.
GK.question: What does a goalkeeper do?

LB.name: Left Back
LB.description: Defends the left flank and overlaps the winger or midfielder to add width and deliver crosses in attack.
LB.question: What does a full-back do?

RB.name: Right Back
RB.description: Defends the right flank and overlaps the winger or midfielder to add width and deliver crosses in attack.
RB.question: What does a full-back do?

LCB.name: Left Centre-Back
LCB.description: Defends the middle of the pitch, wins aerial duels, covers teammates and helps start build-up from the back.
LCB.question: What does a centre-back do?

RCB.name: Right Centre-Back
RCB.description: Defends the middle of the pitch, wins aerial duels, covers teammates and helps start build-up from the back.
RCB.question: What does a centre-back do?

CB.name: Centre-Back
CB.description: The middle of a back three. Organises the defensive line and covers the centre-backs on either side.
CB.question: What does a centre-back do?

LWB.name: Left Wing-Back
LWB.description: Covers the whole left flank. More attacking than a full-back, and provides the team's width on that side.
LWB.question: What does a wing-back do?

RWB.name: Right Wing-Back
RWB.description: Covers the whole right flank. More attacking than a full-back, and provides the team's width on that side.
RWB.question: What does a wing-back do?

DM.name: Defensive Midfielder
DM.description: Sits in front of the defence, breaks up opposition attacks and recycles possession. Often called the No. 6.
DM.question: What does a No. 6 do?

LDM.name: Left Defensive Midfielder
LDM.description: One of two holding midfielders. Shields the back line, wins the ball and keeps possession moving.
LDM.question: What does a No. 6 do?

RDM.name: Right Defensive Midfielder
RDM.description: One of two holding midfielders. Shields the back line, wins the ball and keeps possession moving.
RDM.question: What does a No. 6 do?

LCM.name: Left Central Midfielder
LCM.description: Links defence and attack, covers a lot of ground and arrives late into the box. Often called a No. 8.
LCM.question: What does a No. 8 do?

RCM.name: Right Central Midfielder
RCM.description: Links defence and attack, covers a lot of ground and arrives late into the box. Often called a No. 8.
RCM.question: What does a No. 8 do?

LM.name: Left Midfielder
LM.description: Provides width on the left in a flat midfield, supports the full-back and tracks back when defending.
LM.question: What does a winger do?

RM.name: Right Midfielder
RM.description: Provides width on the right in a flat midfield, supports the full-back and tracks back when defending.
RM.question: What does a winger do?

CAM.name: Attacking Midfielder
CAM.description: Plays between the opposition's midfield and defence, creating chances with the final pass. Often called the No. 10.
CAM.question: What does a No. 10 do?

LW.name: Left Winger
LW.description: Stretches the defence, takes on defenders and either crosses from the byline or cuts inside to shoot.
LW.question: What does a winger do?

RW.name: Right Winger
RW.description: Stretches the defence, takes on defenders and either crosses from the byline or cuts inside to shoot.
RW.question: What does a winger do?

ST.name: Striker
ST.description: Leads the line, finishes chances and often starts the press from the front.
ST.question: What is the difference between a target man and a poacher?

LST.name: Left Striker
LST.description: Half of a strike pair. Works with the other striker to score, hold the ball up and press the centre-backs.
LST.question: What is the difference between a target man and a poacher?

RST.name: Right Striker
RST.description: Half of a strike pair. Works with the other striker to score, hold the ball up and press the centre-backs.
RST.question: What is the difference between a target man and a poacher?
